verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is payments and commerce infrastructure that serves AI agent platforms and merchants. It is not an agent or LLM client that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error. The documented Adyen MCP server is the server role, which belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
